verdict.rationale: Drata tracks personnel as a first-class compliance object. Its docs describe monitoring personnel and exposing Personnel list, search and get APIs, and a community commenter reports that anyone in the corporate directory shows up as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard until they meet requirements, which points to directory-synced per-person compliance tracking. Nothing in the pack documents onboarding or offboarding checklists, an HR-system sync, security-training completion tracking, or verification that leavers' access was revoked. missing for 10: documented HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklists, training-completion evidence per hire, offboarding access-revocation verification, independent hands-on corroboration.
